messages:
Ana: Quick copy pass needed for the 'Delete Dedicated Pool' confirmation modal. PM flagged it's scary but not clear whether data or billing is affected.
Ravi: We should separate consequences: service impact (runs stop), data impact (configs retained or removed), billing (commits still billed?). Need explicit lines.
Hannah: Legal/Finance: committed billing persists until contract end unless org cancels. Don’t promise refunds in the modal.
Ana: Draft modal text: Title: 'Delete dedicated pool?' Body: 'Deleting a dedicated pool will stop all running inference jobs and remove the pool from your org. Configs will be archived but billing commitments remain until the end of your contract. This action cannot be undone.'
Mark: Too wordy. Modal body should be skimmable. Suggest bullets: - Stops running jobs immediately - Pool removed from org - Configs archived (can be restored by support) - Billing commitments remain
Ravi: Also include a short recovery path: 'Contact support to request config restore' — don't promise success.
Hannah: Tone: use active voice and concrete verbs. Avoid 'This action cannot be undone' without offering an undo option. If we show an undo toast, say 'You can request restoration within 48 hours' only if ops can guarantee it. Ops can't promise that, so just 'Contact support to discuss recovery options.'
Ana: Buttons: Primary = 'Delete pool' (danger style). Secondary = 'Cancel'. We also considered 'Delete and notify team' but that's a separate checkbox below.
Mark: Add subtle inline reminder about scope: small note: 'This applies to all projects in the organization.' That prevents surprise. Place it under bullets in muted text.
Ravi: Accessibility: include `aria-describedby` pointing to the impact bullets, and ensure the dialog has role=dialog and focus trap. Keyboard: primary button should autofocus? Maybe not — focus should go to Cancel to avoid accidental destructive actions.
DesignBot: A11y checklist: role="dialog", aria-labelledby -> title, aria-describedby -> body/bullets, focus initial on secondary (Cancel), primary button with aria-label="Delete pool, irreversible", visible focus indicators, color contrast for danger button meets 4.5:1.
Hannah: Undo toast microcopy suggestion (if we can offer short undo window): 'Dedicated pool deleted. Contact support to request restoration.' But since we can't promise restoration, prefer: 'Dedicated pool deleted. Contact support to discuss recovery options.' Primary action on toast: 'Open support' Secondary: 'View activity log'.
Ana: What about changing 'Delete pool' to 'Confirm delete' to reduce reflex clicks? I worry it's less clear.
Mark: 'Delete pool' is clearer and matches global patterns. Keep label explicit. Also include redundancy: primary label + aria-label = 'Delete pool permanently'.
Ravi: For the checkbox option 'Also notify organization' microcopy: 'Notify members in all projects about this deletion.' Keep it short.
Hannah: For empty-state copy after deletion (when pool list is empty): 'No dedicated pools yet. Create a pool to reserve capacity for low-latency inference.' CTA = 'Create pool'.
Ana: Final copy pass summary: 1) Modal title: 'Delete dedicated pool?' 2) Body: short intro + bulleted impacts (stop jobs, remove pool, configs archived, billing commitments remain). 3) Muted org-scope note. 4) Checkbox microcopy: 'Notify organization' with helper text. 5) Buttons: Secondary 'Cancel' (autofocus), Primary 'Delete pool' (danger) with aria-label 'Delete pool permanently'. 6) Toast after deletion: 'Dedicated pool deleted. Contact support to discuss recovery options.' Actions: 'Open support' / 'View activity log'. 7) Empty state copy for zero pools.
Mark: I'll add these to the design spec and attach a mockup. Ping legal/finance to confirm billing phrasing before copy lock.
Ana: Thanks all. Leaving this for copy pass and a11y review. :white_check_mark:
